name: Saudi Arabia
summary: Arabian Peninsula nation with hyper-arid desert climate. High ambient mineral dust levels join heavy oil and gas extraction emissions and energy-intensive seawater desalination.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 11.72x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); natural windblown sand and desert dust dominant across Rub al Khali and Riyadh.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; extreme summer heat with daytime temperatures consistently topping 47 °C.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Rapid warming across Arabian Peninsula desert plateaus over trailing 30-year window.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.8% share of global fossil emissions; world's leading crude oil exporter.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: One of the world's highest per capita footprints due to energy-intensive thermal desalination, cooling, and transport.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Sparse juniper and acacia scrub in the Asir mountain highlands covering ~9,700 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: National Vision 2030 deploying gigawatt-scale solar PV (Sakaka, Sudair) and wind complexes to diversify grid.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 17 people/km²; urban population fraction is 84.7%.
